kagoshima.text: Kagoshima 分みつ糖 factories R7年産: 搬入開始 R7.12.1 (新光糖業 中種子, 南栄糖業 和泊), R7.12.3 (生和糖業), R7.12.10 (富国製糖, 南西糖業 伊仙・徳和瀬), R7.12.12 (与論島製糖); 製糖終了 R8.3.23 (与論) to R8.5.19 (新光糖業 中種子). 製糖期間 = 搬入開始〜製糖終了 incl. idle days.

season.note: Harvest runs in step with factory intake (cane is crushed within days of cutting); 'harvest months' here are inferred from factory intake/manufacturing dates, not a separate harvest-date statistic.

notes: Latest season available for both prefectures as of 2026-11-08 is 令和7/8年期 (2025 crop), not 令和6/7. Okinawa R7/8 report dated 令和8年8月 (page updated 2026-09-08); Kagoshima R7年産 report dated 令和8年9月 (page updated 2026-10-19).
Okinawa 宮古島/伊良部島 sugar values are factory-based: 宮古製糖 城辺工場 also processed some 伊良部 cane, so per-island sugar does not map exactly onto per-island cane.

Okinawa island list covers the 16 islands that have a sugar factory; island rows sum to 13,639 ha / 765,771 t / 91,713 t vs report total 13,638 ha (rounding). 竹富町 split into 小浜/西表/波照間 per the table's sub-rows.

Kagoshima island rows sum to 9,624 ha / 611,387 t / 72,706 t vs report total sugar 72,705 t (rounding, per table note). Kagoshima per-island sugar = 分みつ糖 (company factory) + 含みつ糖 (small factories: 種子島7, 奄美大島15, 喜界島11, 徳之島9, 沖永良部島1, 与論島0; total 43 per Ⅱ-1). Individual small 含みつ糖 factories not listed (no official list fetched).

Kagoshima factory exact addresses were not found in an official source; coordinates are municipality- or 字-level. Okinawa factory addresses come from the prefecture's 分蜜糖工場/含蜜糖工場 lists; coordinates from GSI (国土地理院) address search, precision noted per record.

Okinawa main island: R7/8 tables show only ゆがふ製糖KK (北地区/南部地区 = cane catchment areas). 北部製糖 and 翔南製糖 do not appear in R7/8 tables or the prefecture factory list (status of those plants not separately verified).
ALIC 砂糖類情報 article (鹿児島県糖業振興協会) not used; prefectural reports are primary sources.
Island lat/lon are approximate representative points from GSI place-name/municipality search, not polygon centroids.
